articles.summary: ST. LOUIS, Oct. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Advantage Solutions Inc. (NASDAQ: ADV), announced today that it will release financial results for the third quarter at 7 a.m. EST on November 4, 2026, followed by a conference call at 8:30 a.m. EST on the same day. The conference call can be accessed live by dialing 1-833-461-5787 for U.S. callers or 1-585-542-9983 for international callers. The conference ID is 693618856. Interested investors and other parties may also listen to a simultaneous conference call webcast by logging onto the Investor Relations section of the Advantage Solutions website at ir.youradv.com . A replay of the webcast will be available for a limited time on the Investor Relations section of the Advantage Solutions website at ir.youradv.com . About Advantage Solutions Advantage Solutions is the leading omnichannel retail solutions agency in North America, uniquely positioned at the intersection of consumer-packaged goods (CPG) brands and retailers.
